body.name: recFan
body.space: finite rational conical complexes in \(\mathbb R^d\)
body.def: Form the homogeneous hyperplane arrangement generated by every nonzero row of every \(A_{v,b}\), take all closed sign cones, discard empty cones by exact rational feasibility, and close the surviving cones under faces. The resulting finite complex \(\operatorname{recFan}(\mathfrak G)\) refines every \(\operatorname{rec}(P_{v,b})\), and each flattened component retains its projection to \(v\).
